## Questions

#### N1

Broadcast FM uses peak deviation Δf = 75 kHz and audio bandwidth B = 15 kHz. Find β. [→ Solution](#solution-n1)

#### Solution N1

$\beta = \Delta f/B = 75/15 = 5$. [← Back](#n1)
